pieces.Text: An arachnid wildsoul's wrists can produce thick, sticky webbing that he can shoot at his enemies. Shooting webbing is a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 10 feet. The webbing acts as a tanglefoot bag when it hits a creature, except the DC of the Reflex save to avoid being glued to the floor or unable to fly is
. Like a tanglefoot bag, the webbing does not work underwater. The arachnid wildsoul can shoot webs
